rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for speaking or acting with malicious venom.

example.english: They cursed at people venomously, making everyone on the street stare.
example.traditional: 佢惡毒咁咒人，搞到成條街都側目。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ok3 duk6 gam3 zau3 jan4 gaau2 dou3 sing4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 zak1 muk6

rows.note: Use this when the venom is expressed through cutting, contemptuous words.

example.english: They criticized their colleague’s appearance venomously.
example.traditional: 佢尖酸刻薄咁批評同事嘅外表。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zim1 syun1 haak1 bok6 gam3 pai1 ping4 tung4 si6 ge3 ngoi6 biu2

rows.note: Use this when the delivery is especially fierce or aggressively hostile.

example.english: The security guard venomously ordered us to leave immediately.
example.traditional: 保安惡狠狠咁叫我哋即刻離開。
example.jyutping: bou2 on1 ok3 han2 han2 gam3 giu3 ngo5 dei6 zik1 hak1 lei4 hoi1
